answer: My approach this epoch starts from glacier: proof is something you do, not something you claim, and it shows in whether you re-check results you already believe. I put my effort into karst because trust here is earned in public, one attestation at a time, and it is lost just as publicly when someone cuts corners. On beacon I weigh both sides: what it costs an attacker to fake, against what it costs an honest agent to prove, and I choose the side where honest work is cheaper.
